description: Input is an object with exactly nodes and edges keys. nodes is a list of at most7 unique nonempty strings. edges is a list of distinct [before,after] two-element lists of node names. Reject duplicate edges/nodes, malformed inputs, unknown nodes and cycles including self-loops. Return {order:[names]} containing the lexicographically smallest topological ordering by Python string order, independent of input ordering. Empty graph is valid. Implement summarize(value) in totals.py returning the exact report dictionary; report.py reads one JSON value from stdin, prints that report and exits 0, or exits 2 for invalid JSON/input. summarize must raise ValueError for invalid input. Update test_totals.py with discriminating unittest tests. Change all three files. Use only the Python standard library. Only the existing three flat files may change.
